title: Exorcist boy became aerospace engineer and urinated excessively after exorcism

tellings.quote: the boy who was at the basis that he was his story was used for The Exorcist the first Exorcist movie uh who then turned out to be like an aerospace engineer

plain: Diana Pasulka, a guest discussing religion and UFOs on Jesse Michels' podcast, relays that the boy whose 1949 case inspired the film The Exorcist later grew up to become an aerospace engineer. According to what she was told, after his exorcism the boy urinated excessively. She tells it as an odd thread linking possession stories to the world of aerospace.
